statement: A terminal rolling-restart ACTIVE-gate snapshot preserves logging-retention queue diagnostics separately from membership-publication owner-queue diagnostics, so logging backlog cannot be reported or analyzed as owner-reconcile work and the retained seed-stall signature deterministically names the queue that actually has pending work.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Retain LogsTableService queue fields only under logging-retention diagnostics and membership-publication reconcile queue fields only under the existing membership owner-queue witness. Never combine counts, pressure flags, keys, retry state, or ownership by max, spread, or fallback when both sources are present.

Reuse LogsTableService.getStats and MembershipPublicationService.getControlPlaneOwnerQueueDepth as the two authoritative producers. Do not add a queue, recovery owner, logging owner, or alternate sampling loop.

A deterministic fixture matching the retained N=1 seed stall (logging pendingWrites=515 and pendingWriteGrowthCount=1343; membership owner pending/retrying/in-flight keys empty) must preserve both witnesses and must not select wait_owner_recovery or publication-owner backlog. The inverse fixture with a real membership owner key must continue to select owner recovery.

Older reports that expose only the historically merged logsTable record remain parseable but must be marked legacy/ambiguous or absent; they must not be silently relabelled as source-separated evidence. Preserve null and unknown honestly.

Do not change queue scheduling, logging retention, membership publication, heartbeat or lease behavior, readiness predicates, workload, protocol timers, timeout budgets, or the sealed statistical bar. This Quest restores diagnostic source identity only.

TLA+ can evaluate owner fairness after the actual stalled transition is known, while Alloy can check owner cardinality only if ownership changes. This diagnostic source-separation Quest changes neither transition semantics nor owner cardinality, so do not extend either model; run existing model contracts only if an adjacent architecture contract is edited.
